indexationStatus.coverage: The live sitemap is reachable and robots.txt allows general search crawlers, including Bingbot through User-agent: *. No Bing Webmaster Tools API/export is configured in the repository, so discovered/indexed URL counts could not be independently verified.

notes: W28 provider exports were recovered locally after GitHub-hosted runner capacity prevented the scheduled Data Signals jobs from starting.
GSC recorded 498 organic clicks in W28, so the prior ~100 clicks/week deferral threshold for privacy-aggregated first-party behavior analysis is no longer applicable.
The W28 first-party analytics export was initially absent because Cloudflare interpreted numeric weekday 1 as Sunday while the export logic assumes Monday; repair is tracked in PR #330.
